title: Probation midpoint summary + hiring action items
content:
Purpose:
Weekly synthesis of probation midpoint check-ins (week 6 for the July cohort) + immediate hiring actions and risk flags. Intended audience: eng leads, hiring managers, talent partners. Quick read: 4 min.

Attendees / input sources:
- Priya (owner) ran consolidated 1:1s and compiled feedback.
- Ethan: onboarding checklist + infra access logs.
- Maya: learning path / mentorship notes.
- Samir: hiring funnel updates and interview debriefs.
- Input from 6 new engineers via 1:1s and async survey (pulse).

Executive summary:
- Overall sentiment: cautiously positive. New hires report good technical onboarding but uneven pairing availability. Two hires (L2 SWE candidates from international hiring batch) are flagging for ramp velocity due to intermittent infra access and delayed mentor time.
- Risks: access friction causing context loss, one candidate at risk for probation extension recommendation if no change in next 2 weeks.
- Hiring pipeline: we have 3 strong candidates in loop for mid-senior backend and 1 ops candidate with start target Oct. Need to accelerate final interviews to avoid losing bench.

Detailed notes:
1) Ramp and blockers:
- Access: intermittent GCP project permissions (ticket ENG-OPS-339) blocked use of test clusters for 3 new hires for 2 working days last week. Result: missed pairing sessions and delayed first internal bugfix PRs.
- Mentorship bandwidth: mentors reported multi-day meetings conflicts (Q3 hiring spike). We should temporarily reduce mentor to mentee ratio by 20% via rotating pairing sessions with adjacent teams.
- Learning path usage: onboarding module completion rate 78% at week 6. Most skipped: "serving-runtime local dev" lab (hard dependency on infra).

2) Probation-specific check-ins (per person summary, anonymized):
- New hire A (backend): strong systems thinking, slowed by infra access. Suggest targeted infra onboarding session + pairing with SRE.
- New hire B (inference infra): ramping well, delivered first draft of cache warmup test; recommend regular syncs with serving-runtime lead.
- New hire C (platform): lower participation in weekly demos; reported unclear expectations — action: manager to send concrete sprint goals for next 2 weeks.
- New hire D (tools): missed coding standards on first PR; mentors note faster improvement after pair review. No probation risk.

3) Interview debrief pattern observations (recent 6 debriefs):
- Interviewers are diverging on rubric interpretation for mid-senior backend: frequency of algorithmic vs systems questions inconsistent. Outcome: extend rubric with explicit weighting for production design questions. Owner: Samir (due 2025-09-16).
- Feedback latency: debriefs being submitted 48–72 hours post interview. This is delaying offers. Request: interviewers commit to same-day or EOD comments.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- ENG-OPS-339 (triage infra permission issue): Priya to escalate to infra lead; target resolution 2025-09-04.
- Mentor coverage plan: Ethan to propose rotational pairing schedule and temporary pairing pool by 2025-09-08.
- Rubric update for backend hiring: Samir to draft weighted rubric + sample questions by 2025-09-16.
- Probation rescue plan for New hire A: manager (Maya) to run 1:1 twice weekly and schedule infra deep-dive; check-in 2025-09-10.
- Interviewer feedback SLA: hiring managers to push guideline in next hiring standup; proposed SLA = comments within 24 hours.

Signal metrics to watch (next two weeks):
- Onboarding module completion delta (target +10% by 2025-09-16).
- Number of delayed debriefs (>24h) (target <20%).
- Number of blocked pairing hours logged (target 0).

Open questions / discussion points for next hiring sync:
- Can we provision a small, dedicated test cluster for new hires to avoid noisy permission changes? (cost vs productivity tradeoff)
- Should we adopt a mandatory interviewer calibration session for mid-senior backend roles? Frequency: monthly vs quarterly?

Notes / friction examples (raw snippets captured):
- "Spent an entire morning waiting for service account perms — I lost the pairing slot with my mentor" (quote).
- "I enjoyed the cache warmup test — felt like a real, productive task" (quote).

Attachments / references:
- Linked doc: CON-1945 (onboarding playbook draft).
- Jira: ENG-ONB-72 (probation tracking board).
- PR: ops repo PR #382 — infra helper scripts used during onboarding.

Proposed temporary mitigations (do this this week):
- Stand up a "new-hire triage" Slack channel and assign an on-call mentor each weekday for first 4 weeks.
- Reserve two 90-min pairing blocks twice weekly where mentors are explicitly blocked for pairing sessions.

If nothing changes in 2 weeks:
- We will escalate a probation extension recommendation for any hire still missing infra access or failing to meet 1:1 progress goals.

Next check-in:
- Follow-up summary due 2025-09-16. Quick sync (15 min) on 2025-09-10 to confirm infra resolution.

Questions / feedback welcome — add comments in Slack thread or reply to this doc.
